items.title: Producely Dialr: This Plugin Controller Maps with AI!
items.excerpt: First shown at Superbooth25, the Producely Dialr hardware controller is now orderable: an AI-assisted mapping engine reads whatever plugin is in focus and assigns its most useful parameters to the knobs automatically, removing the MIDI-learn step from hands-on mixing and sound design.

items.title: Audacity 4 Is Finally Here: The Biggest Update in the Editor's History
items.excerpt: Audacity 4 ships a redesigned clip workflow, Workspaces and a full visual overhaul — and keeps the Intel OpenVINO AI toolset (music separation, noise suppression, transcription, music generation) plus new AI-powered podcast features inside a free, open-source editor.

items.title: Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke join 'responsible' AI music company Moises as advisors
items.excerpt: Two headline DJ-producers have signed on as advisors to Moises, whose stem-separation, AI mixing/mastering and generative session-player tools are trained only on licensed and authorised content. The pair will steer how the toolset is shaped for working producers.

items.title: Alok fans get personalised music video with headphone purchases
items.excerpt: Alok and agency Rise New York & Partners turned a headphone purchase into an AI-generated music video that is unique for every buyer — a production pipeline where the 'one video per release' assumption is replaced by per-fan rendering.

items.title: Report explores AI's indies impact and infrastructure erosion
items.excerpt: Research firm Stvdio and Secretly Distribution published a study of the independent sector, arguing that generative AI plus platform economics is eroding the infrastructure — studios, labels, distributors — that independent creative work depends on.

items.title: Big & Rich Take on Artificial Intelligence on Ominous New Song 'Hello AI'
items.excerpt: Rather than issuing a statement, country duo Big & Rich lodged their protest against AI as a song — 'Hello AI' — putting the argument about machine-made music inside the craft itself.

items.title: Creating plugins in Suno Studio 2.0
items.excerpt: Suno's own walkthrough of building custom audio plugins from the chat bar inside Studio 2.0 — the vendor showing how a prompt becomes a signal-processing device in a working session.

items.title: Audio Effects & Plugins in Suno Studio 2.0
items.excerpt: Hands-on tour of the factory effects chain — sidechain compression, convolution reverb, automation curves — that turns Suno's generative output into something mixable rather than a finished export.

items.title: ElevenLabs Changelog: Everything We Shipped This Month
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' monthly shipping roundup covering its music and audio model updates and creative-tool changes — a fast read on how quickly the generative audio stack is moving for creators.
